# Recommended GitHub labels

Create these in **Settings → Labels** so contributors can find starter work:

| Label | Color (suggestion) | Use for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `good first issue` | `#7057ff` | Small, scoped tasks; see [good first contributions](https://lessonkit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/project/good-first-contributions.html) |
| `help wanted` | `#008672` | Larger tasks where maintainer guidance is available |
| `documentation` | `#0075ca` | Docs site, README, package READMEs |
| `examples` | `#fbca04` | Example apps, demo courses, Storybook stories |
| `good-first-contributions` | (optional) | Meta issues listing onboarding improvements |

Link new contributors to [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the **good first issue** filter:  
`https://github.com/eddiethedean/lessonkit/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22`
